text_block_list.text:
Starting today, the summer training camp
for improving skills begins.

text_block_list.name: Hishi Amazon
text_block_list.text:
Oh, it's been a whole year!
Brings back memories.

text_block_list.name: Hishi Amazon
text_block_list.text:
Last year, if I recall... my trainer was panicking
all over the place, wasn't he? Ahaha!

text_block_list.name: Hishi Amazon
text_block_list.text:
Just kidding.
Looking back on it now, it was totally my fault!

text_block_list.name: Hishi Amazon
text_block_list.text:
It's because I hadn't given you
a reason to truly believe in me yet.

text_block_list.name: Hishi Amazon
text_block_list.text:
How are you doing right now?
You're not feeling anxious, are you?
Hishi Amazon's running in the Osaka Hai and then the Yasuda Kinen was unmatched in all the world.

text_block_list.name: Hishi Amazon
text_block_list.text: Heheh, well that's great to hear!

And so, the passionate summer training camp
with Hishi Amazon began!
